input_fields.name: active_document_state
input_fields.description: Observed model-document state, title/path/hash, active marker, and script-console distinction.

input_fields.name: expected_document_identity
input_fields.description: Expected path/hash/title or explicit unsaved-document marker.

result_fields.name: match_status
result_fields.description: One of matched, mismatched, unavailable, or needs_manual_review.

result_fields.name: active_document_identity
result_fields.description: Observed actual document identity and active-session binding.

procedure: Observe the active model document, not a script tab, console title, or planned output name.
Normalize path, hash, title, and unsaved marker into active_document_identity.
Compare with expected_document_identity and return match_status.
Do not focus another document or repair the mismatch in this atom.
rejection_rules: Reject missing identity or a script-console label presented as a model document.
Do not load, run, save, or close a document while unresolved.
